inspiration: Scaling Image Geo-Localization to Continent Level: ground prototypes, boundary interpolation, multi-similarity ground-prototype edge
differences: Frozen ResNet-DINO input; no encoder optimization, no aerial imagery/encoder or S2; local regular 2/5km grids; no full ETH reproduction
selection: Apply all safety conditions to each candidate before ranking eligible candidates by within5, median and within25; current retrieval eligible
selection_amendment: Corrected candidate-level guardrail filtering after validation inspection and before test. Original highest-within5 candidate failed median guardrail. This is an exploratory amendment, not a pristine preregistration.
promotion: within5 improves >=.5pp; within25 no worse by >.5pp; median <=1.02x current
test: Only evaluate after promotion gate; benchmark reused, not independent confirmation
storage: reuse cached frozen descriptors; no raw image download
